description: The plot illustrates the loss of different models over the number of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 140,000 with a tick label interval of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with a tick label interval of 0.1. The plot displays five lines representing different models: StrmLLM (n=64) in blue with a solid line style, SepLLM (n=64) in orange, SepLLM (n=64, H) in green, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) in red, and SepLLM (n=128) in dark blue. All lines exhibit a decreasing trend as the number of iterations increases, starting from around 3.4 at 0 iterations and decreasing to between 2.5 and 2.6 at 140,000 iterations. Specifically, StrmLLM (n=64) starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at around 2.65, SepLLM (n=64) starts at 3.4 and ends at about 2.55, SepLLM (n=64, H) begins at 3.4 and ends at roughly 2.53, SepLLM (n=64, H/T) starts at 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.52, and SepLLM (n=128) starts at 3.4 and ends at around 2.6. Each line has a shaded area around it, indicating the range of loss values. The lines decrease rapidly in the initial iterations, with the rate of decrease slowing down as the number of iterations increases.
